meta.label: POST HOC / registered-exploratory (X2 only); never a claim; confirmatory outcome B is not re-decided
meta.revision: 2026-10-07: fixes from verification/VERIFY.md applied (CHANGES_2026-10-07.md); still POST HOC, nothing is a finding
meta.lme_optimizer: nlme default (nlminb); the opt = 'optim' control was dropped (VERIFY.md sec. 3.1)

declared_deviations.X2_constants: Q25 required the X2 constants in the amendment-2 module before any chi existed; they were not there. Dr = 274 Hz/ppm and R2 = 0 were fixed after unlock from Dimov et al. 2022, not tuned; Dr range reported.
declared_deviations.R2s_voxel_set: Prereg (LEADchi_prereg_v1.0_FINAL.md line 253) defines R2*_ROI on the same voxel sets as the matching chi ROI, restricted to Mask 3. extract_rois.py (lines 289-295) uses Mask 3 & finite R2* within the ROI, without the chi support S or the implausible-voxel exclusion. Departure from the plan text; also affects the frozen K2 and PC3.
declared_deviations.BH_family: Q25 says 'BH-FDR within block' without defining the block. X2-only families (6 and 18 tests) are used here; pooling with the 5 registered Tier-4 tests is reported as a sensitivity (A_X2_BH_family_sensitivity.csv).
